newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Kilpatrick Green lists at 12 pct premium.
newsitem.headline: Kilpatrick Green lists at 12 pct premium.

text.p: Shares in facilities management group Kilpatrick Green Holdings Ltd made their debut on the Australian Stock Exchange at 50.5 cents on Friday, a 12 percent premium to their 45 cent issue price.
Forty million shares were offered with brokers A.B.S. White underwriting the float.

Kilpatrick Green operates in Australia, New Zealand and south east Asia and their activities include design and engineering in fields such as power generation, distribution and transmission systems, water systems and wastewater treatment, communications, facility management and electrical and mechanical contracting.
The company said that in the year ended 30 June 1996, turnover was A$186 million with forecasts for 1997 and 1998 exceeding $230 million and $260 million respectively.
Fully franked dividends are forecast at 0.9 cents for the final 1997 dividend and 2.8 cents in 1998.
By 11.25 a.m. (0125 GMT), Kilpatrick Green shares were trading at 50 cents on turnover of 764,000 shares.
